# Energy Market Analytics Instructions

Read and follow `AGENTS.md`. This repository is a natural gas research and data
pipeline project, not an automated trading system.

Use `uv` and run the relevant fetcher before proposing a completed pipeline
change. Keep changes focused. Do not commit credentials or unrelated generated
files. Committed parquet files in `data/` are expected project state, but inspect
data diffs carefully and explain any schema, source, or timing impact.
